title.en: Fable 19 — The Two Travellers and the Bear

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: שני חברים הלכו יחד בדרך ביער.
sentences.en: Two friends walked together on a road in the forest.

sentences.ar: הם דיברו כל הזמן ולא פחדו.
sentences.en: They talked all the time and were not afraid.
One said: we are real friends.
The second said: true, and forever.

sentences.ar: פתאום יצא דוב גדול מבין העצים.
sentences.en: Suddenly a big bear came out from among the trees.

sentences.ar: הראשון רץ מיד ועלה על עץ.
sentences.en: The first ran at once and climbed a tree.

sentences.ar: הוא לא קרא לחבר שלו בכלל.
sentences.en: He did not call his friend at all.

sentences.ar: השני לא ידע לעלות על עצים.
sentences.en: The second did not know how to climb trees.

sentences.ar: הוא שכב על האדמה ולא זז.
sentences.en: He lay on the ground and did not move.
The bear came and smelled him slowly.

sentences.ar: הוא שם את האף ליד האוזן.
sentences.en: It put its nose beside his ear.
And then it went away quietly.
The first came down from the tree and laughed.

sentences.ar: הוא שאל: מה הדוב אמר לך?
sentences.en: He asked: what did the bear say to you?
The second got up and cleaned his clothes.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הוא אמר לי דבר אחד.
sentences.en: He said: it said one thing to me.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אל תלך עם מי שבורח.
sentences.en: He said: do not walk with one who runs away.
